summary: Tessie Strickland, 64, of Kentwood LA and husband Tommy were Jeep touring on Forest Service Road 520 (Stony Pass); Jeep stalled and was swept downstream while crossing Pole Creek in the evening; both jumped from the roof, Tommy reached shore, Tessie was swept away; 8-mile ground/drone search by 25+ personnel with DFPC helicopter; never located.
location: Pole Creek crossing, Stony Pass (Forest Service Road 520), near Silverton
responding_agency: San Juan County Sheriff's Office, Silverton Medical Rescue, Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control
notes: Incident evening of Jun 27 (date per AP report timeline: crossed Thursday morning, swept away Thursday evening; search continued Monday Jul 1); outcome fatality (presumed; never located).
